name: updated-at-field-overwritten-on-insert
$comment: Server-stamped updatedAtField (FM-36): an insert supplying its own updatedAt value has it overwritten by the server's epoch-ms stamp. Determinism: the follow-up read filters updatedAt > 123 — a kept client value (123 > 123 is false) or an absent key would not match, so only a server stamp (wall-clock epoch-ms, far past 123) makes the row visible. The stamped value itself is generated, so it is normalized out of the expected doc.
